prose_updates.tldr: The causal target is cohort-weighted buy-and-hold level wealth at a fixed realized event path, identified by consistency and an explicitly untestable event-date counterfactual transport equality. Historical proxy paths are observed exactly, whereas the event path alone is generated from an independent donor sample with unknown full covariance. A separate, noncausal design-conditional centering condition formalizes the replicated-response and treated-mean sampling channels while leaving within-unit training/event dependence unrestricted; it does not identify event-date transport. On this repaired class and conditional on the disclosed attainable-direction restriction, the stated contribution is a conditional realized-geometry minimax frontier, its four-channel marginal phase diagram, and the matching uniformly honest expected-length frontier. The common-design-shock witness is retained only to show why deleting design-conditional centering invalidates those rates, even after averaging over the design. Exact constants at phase intersections remain open.

project_justification.fill: The project separates three logically different ingredients: causal identification by consistency and event-date transport, observed-law sampling control by design-conditional centering, and nonregular donor difficulty by the covariance-standardized local modulus. The repaired model states that untreated response blocks are centered at \(m_s(X_{st})\) conditional on the full exact design and that the treated event mean is invariant to that design, without imposing independence between a unit's training responses and event outcome. On that class the target positive results remain the conditional, marginal, and honest-length four-channel frontiers; the common-design-shock construction is a necessity witness only for the larger class obtained by deleting the centering condition. Projected donor centers, finite safeguarded bandwidth search, clipped fits, calendar blocks, and full-range bad-sample intervals keep the proposed procedures samplewise total.

sampling_model.units: Each cohort supplies \(n_s\) replicated untreated wealth blocks per pre-event window and \(n_s\) treated event wealth levels. Conditional on the full exact path-design sigma-field and \(z_0\), each untreated block has mean \(m_s(X_{st})\), the treated event mean equals its mean conditional only on \(z_0\), and joint unit histories are independent across units. Dependence between a given unit's pre-event responses and event outcome remains unrestricted; the pre-event calendar sequence is geometrically beta-mixing.
sampling_model.treatment: A cohort enters the event path once. Consistency links observed event wealth to treated potential wealth. Design-conditional centering controls only the observed treated-mean sampling channel, whereas the separately maintained event-date transport equality supplies the untreated event-date counterfactual mean. Neither observed-law centering nor rolling untreated pseudo-events identify that cross-date counterfactual equality.

prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: The no-deconvolution conclusion is conditional on the exact observation structure. If an estimated proxy map is applied to every pre-event row, a generated-regressor expansion becomes relevant; if only noisy replicates of every latent training coordinate are observed, a deconvolution experiment applies. Design-conditional centering is also indispensable for the advertised conditional replication rates: after it is deleted, the common-design-shock construction yields constant conditional and marginal risk despite \(R_D\to0\) and \(R_{\star}\to0\). That necessity result does not replace or redefine the positive frontier on the repaired class. The pointwise spacing term is \(T^{-2\lambda/d}\); uniform coverage over every path in the cube would generally require a global fill-distance analysis. Totalization does not permit exceptional samples to be ignored: the upper-bound and expected-length proofs must count every bandwidth fallback, inadequate block count, undefined variance denominator, and full-range interval contribution. The worked law \(P_{\mathrm{ex}}\) establishes only that the attainable-direction restriction is non-vacuous; it does not derive that restriction for the general panel class.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The event-date transport equality remains a maintained cross-date counterfactual restriction that the observed design cannot test. The design-conditional centering condition is instead a standard noncausal restriction on observed conditional means; it is required by the named \(n_s^{-1}\) replication channels and allows arbitrary within-unit training/event dependence. Deleting that condition produces the common-design-shock obstruction, and averaging over the design does not cure it. On the repaired class, the \(N^{-\kappa}\) MSE converse and the \(N^{-\kappa/2}\) expected-length converse remain conditional on \texttt{ass:attainable-local-modulus}, so the three positive frontier theorems remain capped at field tier. The effective dimension is \(d=p(H+1)\). Exact minimax constants, automatic smoothness adaptation, growing path dimension, and uniform-in-path bands remain open.

statement_notes.justification: The positive conditional frontier is stated on the replicated-sampling class whose observed responses and treated event means are centered conditional on the realized exact design. This standard sampling premise is distinct from both causal transport and the attainable donor-modulus direction.
statement_notes.gap: Without design-conditional centering, a design-selected mean shock survives unit and calendar averaging and invalidates both the estimator upper bound and the claimed minimax scale. The repaired theorem keeps the four-channel frontier rather than replacing it with that larger-class obstruction.
statement_notes.consumer: Applied users must justify the observed-law centering of replicated blocks and treated event means before interpreting the conditional rate, separately from defending event-date counterfactual transport.

Thus the oracle region is \(N^{-\kappa}=o(R_{\mathrm{or}})\), the generated-proxy region is \(R_{\mathrm{or}}=o(N^{-\kappa})\), and their boundary is \(N\asymp R_{\mathrm{or}}^{-1/\kappa}\), where \(R_{\mathrm{or}}\) is the maximum of the treated-mean, replicated-smoothing, and spacing terms.
